svg.title: Hill climb on the dev set
svg.desc: Dev score by round. The bare model starts at 12.2. Round 1: r1a scored 42.9 (paired lower bound 25.5), r1b scored 26.8 (paired lower bound 9.8); accepted r1a. Round 2: r2a scored 41.0 (paired lower bound -7.0), r2b scored 33.8 (paired lower bound -14.1); nothing accepted. Round 3: r3a scored 41.3 (paired lower bound -6.9), r3b scored 36.2 (paired lower bound -12.2); nothing accepted. Round 4: r4a scored 35.7 (paired lower bound -12.7), r4b scored 35.0 (paired lower bound -13.2); nothing accepted. Round 5: r5a scored 43.5 (paired lower bound -5.0), r5b scored 40.8 (paired lower bound -6.9); nothing accepted. After the climb, exploratory: one-rule edits: x-minimal-a scored 43.1 (paired lower bound -4.7), x-minimal-b scored 40.2 (paired lower bound -6.8); + calc tool: x-calc-a scored 59.9 (paired lower bound 11.7), x-calc-b scored 43.0 (paired lower bound -3.9).
